shared_elements: vertical standing monolith conceived as an anthropomorphic figure
distinct head/top block set above a broad body shaft
low-relief motifs applied to the front of the shaft
limb-like relief element descending the front/side of the body
schematic, flattened relief on a columnar body
justification: Both depict a standing, columnar anthropomorphic being whose broad body carries shallow relief motifs beneath a distinctly separated head/top block, with a limb-like relief running down the front of the shaft — a genuinely comparable overall conception. But the specific iconography differs: A shows a face, headdress, banded girdle-like registers and a prominent central disc on the chest, while B shows no face at all and instead a quadruped animal in relief crawling head-down beside a long vertical snake-like element.
